items.headline: Passan: 2026-27 MLB offseason preview, free agent updates
items.description: The hot stove is about to get blazing hot. Here's what will shape the coming weeks of offseason moves.

items.headline: Angels acquire infielder Jace Jung from Tigers for cash
items.description: The Angels acquired infielder Jace Jung from the Tigers for cash on Wednesday, giving the 2022 first-round draft pick a fresh start.

items.headline: Red Sox acquire catcher Nick Fortes in trade with Rays
items.description: The Red Sox traded for catcher Nick Fortes, who started 78 games behind the plate for the Rays last season, while sending a minor league pitcher to Tampa Bay.

items.headline: MLB expects $4B Angels sale to Kroenke to close in January
items.description: Major League Baseball expects the proposed sale of the Los Angeles Angels to Kroenke Sports and Entertainment at a $4 billion evaluation to take place in January.

items.headline: Twins reunite with veteran right-hander Sonny Gray on two-year deal
items.description: The Twins have signed free agent right-hander Sonny Gray to a two-year contract, the team announced. The deal is for $55 million and includes an opt-out after the first season, sources told ESPN's Jeff Passan.

items.headline: Royals send Maikel Garcia to Mariners in six-player trade
items.description: The Royals have traded third baseman Maikel Garcia to the Mariners in exchange for right-hander Bryce Miller as part of a six-player trade.
